how: python3 -m assistant.core.eval all --json (dev split). A5 (2026-09-30) re-record over the GROWN arena: +31 items (n01..n34, n03/n32 cut) mined from the failure classes of the sealed baseline look (0.7778) — sibling-tool swaps, auto-hide families, position-vs-alignment, absolute-vs-scale, keep-awake, unit spellings. No sealed text copied; phrasings are new. Items whose honest answer is a clarifying question assert expect_verdict=AMBIGUOUS. The set is deliberately HARDER than the pre-growth 90-item set (pre-growth top1 floor was 0.9556): raw rates are not comparable across the growth — per-class deltas are tracked in the build state and CHANGELOG. What matters: the previously-sealed-only classes are now measured on dev, where they can be fixed under the ratchet. baseline.json also records confident_wrong.rate — the doctor's arena-smoke bar — because the growth made a fixed 2% constant dishonest. confident_wrong is the FUSED rate (after A2 demote-only label fusion) — the shipped pipeline behavior.
